page_note: This page presents a five-fold teaching about cosmic "mysteries"/"ordinations," each explicitly mapped onto contemporary human practice. The substrate consists of the cosmic narrative kernels (Father of Life and Mother of the Living bringing Mankind from the Deep; Living Spirit saving First Man, the enthronement formula "Sit, my son, my firstborn, at my right hand"; Mind of light descending in the five-fold type). Each cosmic event is followed by an editorial pivot — "this became the one that exists today in the midst of men, when they X one another" — that crosses out of the cosmic system into the editor's contemporary religious world. The second half drifts strongly into ecclesial application (Church, kiss of love, son of peace, reckoned to the right, joined to the Church) — exactly matching the strong fatigue signal (cosmological 10.8→2.4, ecclesial 18.4→7.8 absolute, but the proportion of ecclesial increases). The Psalm 110 citation "Sit at my right hand" embedded in the cosmic enthronement is interesting — likely substrate appropriating an older royal formula.
